shots.text: The Tidal Leviathan sank into the black water, and the bells in it rang true again.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The ice-eel collapsing; drowned bronze bells rising out of the water and ringing. Thalassa rising from the lake, sea-glass and current, the bells floating in her hair.

shots.text: I remember all of it. Every ship. Every child. I will remember you, too.
shots.speaker: thalassa
shots.art_note: Thalassa looking down at the towers and heroes.

shots.text:
That night, Mirelle looked into the ice for a long time. She said she had seen a death at the very end of the war.

She would not say whose.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Mirelle alone on the shore with the ice staff, her blind eyes glowing, reflections in the ice of something we cannot make out. Behind her, the fleet of Pearlhaven sailing west, the harbour steaming.
